#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GET /v1/trust/presentation-sync/receipt 冒烟测试（临时脚本）。"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization  # noqa: E402
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec  # noqa: E402

from vcbackend import crypto  # noqa: E402

failures = []


def check(name, cond):
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name)
    if not cond:
        failures.append(name)


def _http(method, url, payload=None, headers=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read()


def wait_up(port, timeout=10.0):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            _http("GET", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")
            return True
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.15)
    return False


def _keypair():
    priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    priv_pem = priv.private_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
        encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption(),
    ).decode()
    pub_pem = priv.public_key().public_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo,
    ).decode()
    return priv_pem, pub_pem


def main():
    port = 9317
    store_path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    env = dict(os.environ, VCBACKEND_STORE=store_path)

    def start():
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "vcbackend.cli", "serve",
             "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"],
            cwd=ROOT, env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        assert wait_up(port), "服务启动超时"
        return proc

    proc = start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    RECEIPT = "/v1/trust/presentation-sync/receipt"

    def post(path, payload=None, headers=None):
        return _http("POST", base + path, payload=payload, headers=headers)

    def get(path, headers=None):
        return _http("GET", base + path, headers=headers)

    try:
        DST = {"X-Tenant-ID": "dst-rcpt"}
        OTHER = {"X-Tenant-ID": "other-rcpt"}

        signer_priv, signer_pub = _keypair()
        signer_did = "did:web:rcpt-signer.example"
        st, _ = post("/v1/trust/anchors",
                     {"did": signer_did, "public_key": signer_pub,
                      "key_version": 1}, DST)
        assert st in (200, 201), st

        # 验证者 DID（服务端托管密钥）
        _, vpub = _keypair()
        st, raw = post("/v1/dids",
                       {"method": "web", "public_key": vpub}, DST)
        assert st == 201, (st, raw)
        verifier_did = json.loads(raw)["did"]

        # 停用另一个 DID 供 409 用
        st, raw = post("/v1/dids",
                       {"method": "web", "public_key": vpub}, DST)
        dead_did = json.loads(raw)["did"]
        st, _ = post(f"/v1/dids/{urllib.parse.quote(dead_did)}/deactivate",
                     {}, DST)
        assert st == 200, st

        def signed_manifest(snapshot, after, ndjson):
            m = {
                "snapshot": snapshot,
                "filters": {"after": after, "limit": 1000},
                "count": ndjson.count("\n"),
                "alg": "SHA-256",
                "digest": hashlib.sha256(ndjson.encode()).hexdigest(),
                "signer_did": signer_did,
                "key_version": 1,
            }
            m["signature"] = crypto.sign(
                {k: m[k] for k in ("snapshot", "filters", "count", "alg",
                                   "digest", "signer_did", "key_version")},
                signer_priv)
            return m

        rows = [
            {"cursor": c,
             "consumption_id": f"cons-{i:060d}",
             "issuer_did": "did:web:rcpt-issuer.example",
             "presentation_id": f"vp_{i:03d}",
             "consumed_at": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
            for i, c in enumerate([3, 7, 11], 1)
        ]
        ndjson = "".join(
            json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
            for r in rows
        )
        st, body = post("/v1/trust/presentation-sync",
                        {"manifest": signed_manifest(11, 0, ndjson),
                         "ndjson": ndjson}, DST)
        assert st == 201, (st, body)

        def receipt(qs, headers=DST):
            st, raw = get(f"{RECEIPT}?{qs}", headers=headers)
            return st, json.loads(raw.decode() or "null")

        q = (f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
             f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}&nonce=n1")

        # ---- 400 系列 ----
        st, body = receipt("")
        check("缺参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did=v")
        check("缺 nonce 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(q + "&extra=1")
        check("未知参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(q + "&nonce=n2")
        check("重复参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did=&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=n1")
        check("空 signer 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=")
        check("空 nonce 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        long_nonce = "x" * 257
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did={verifier_did}"
            f"&nonce={long_nonce}")
        check("nonce 超长 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        n256 = "x" * 256
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}&nonce={n256}")
        check("nonce 256 码点合法", st == 200)
        st, body = get(f"{RECEIPT}?{q}", headers={"X-Tenant-ID": ""})
        check("空租户头 400", st == 400)

        # ---- 404 / 409 ----
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did=did:web:nope&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=n1")
        check("来源不存在 404", st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did=did:web:nope&nonce=n1")
        check("验证者不存在 404",
              st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(q, headers=OTHER)
        check("跨租户 404", st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(dead_did)}&nonce=n1")
        check("验证者停用 409",
              st == 409 and body == {"error": "验证者已停用"})

        # ---- 200 ----
        st, body = receipt(q)
        check("200 键序", st == 200 and list(body) == ["receipt", "signature"])
        r = body["receipt"]
        check("receipt 键序", list(r) == [
            "signer_did", "next_after", "digest", "verifier_did",
            "verifier_key_version", "nonce"])
        check("next_after", r["next_after"] == 11)
        check("nonce 回显", r["nonce"] == "n1")
        check("signer/verifier 回显",
              r["signer_did"] == signer_did and
              r["verifier_did"] == verifier_did)
        check("版本正整数", isinstance(r["verifier_key_version"], int)
              and r["verifier_key_version"] >= 1)
        expect_digest = hashlib.sha256(ndjson.encode()).hexdigest()
        check("digest", r["digest"] == expect_digest)

        # 签名可验：取验证者 DID 文档公钥
        st, raw = get(f"/v1/dids/{urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}/document",
                      headers=DST)
        doc = json.loads(raw)
        pub_pem = doc["verification_method"][0]["public_key_pem"] \
            if "verification_method" in doc else doc["public_key"]
        try:
            crypto.verify(r, body["signature"], pub_pem)
            check("签名可验", True)
        except Exception as exc:
            print("verify error:", exc)
            check("签名可验", False)

        # 只读：再次请求结果一致（除签名随机性外 receipt 相同）
        st, body2 = receipt(q)
        check("重复请求 receipt 相同", body2["receipt"] == r)

        # ---- 重启后 receipt/digest 相同、签名可验 ----
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()
        proc = start()
        st, body3 = receipt(q)
        check("重启后 receipt 相同", body3["receipt"] == r)
        try:
            crypto.verify(body3["receipt"], body3["signature"], pub_pem)
            check("重启后签名可验", True)
        except Exception:
            check("重启后签名可验", False)
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()
        if os.path.exists(store_path):
            os.unlink(store_path)

    if failures:
        print("\n失败:", failures)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("\n全部通过")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec  # noqa: E402

failures = []


def check(name, cond):
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name)

        failures.append(name)


def _http(method, url, payload=None, headers=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read()


def wait_up(port, timeout=10.0):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            _http("GET", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")
            return True
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.15)
    return False


def _keypair():
    priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    priv_pem = priv.private_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
        encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption(),
    ).decode()
    pub_pem = priv.public_key().public_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo,
    ).decode()
    return priv_pem, pub_pem

    port = 9317

                "key_version": 1,

            m["signature"] = crypto.sign(

                                   "digest", "signer_did", "key_version")},

            return m

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""GET /v1/trust/presentation-sync/receipt 冒烟测试（临时脚本）。"""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization  # noqa: E402
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec  # noqa: E402

from vcbackend import crypto  # noqa: E402

failures = []


def check(name, cond):
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), name)
    if not cond:
        failures.append(name)


def _http(method, url, payload=None, headers=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    for k, v in (headers or {}).items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read()


def wait_up(port, timeout=10.0):
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            _http("GET", f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")
            return True
        except OSError:
            time.sleep(0.15)
    return False


def _keypair():
    priv = ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
    priv_pem = priv.private_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
        encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption(),
    ).decode()
    pub_pem = priv.public_key().public_bytes(
        encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
        format=serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo,
    ).decode()
    return priv_pem, pub_pem


def main():
    port = 9317
    store_path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    env = dict(os.environ, VCBACKEND_STORE=store_path)

    def start():
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "vcbackend.cli", "serve",
             "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"],
            cwd=ROOT, env=env,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        )
        assert wait_up(port), "服务启动超时"
        return proc

    proc = start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    RECEIPT = "/v1/trust/presentation-sync/receipt"

    def post(path, payload=None, headers=None):
        return _http("POST", base + path, payload=payload, headers=headers)

    def get(path, headers=None):
        return _http("GET", base + path, headers=headers)

    try:
        DST = {"X-Tenant-ID": "dst-rcpt"}
        OTHER = {"X-Tenant-ID": "other-rcpt"}

        signer_priv, signer_pub = _keypair()
        signer_did = "did:web:rcpt-signer.example"
        st, _ = post("/v1/trust/anchors",
                     {"did": signer_did, "public_key": signer_pub,
                      "key_version": 1}, DST)
        assert st in (200, 201), st

        # 验证者 DID（服务端托管密钥）
        st, raw = post("/v1/dids",
                       {"method": "web", "public_key": "rcpt-verifier"}, DST)
        assert st == 201, (st, raw)
        verifier_did = json.loads(raw)["did"]

        # 停用另一个 DID 供 409 用
        st, raw = post("/v1/dids",
                       {"method": "web", "public_key": "rcpt-dead"}, DST)
        dead_did = json.loads(raw)["did"]
        st, _ = post(f"/v1/dids/{urllib.parse.quote(dead_did)}/deactivate",
                     {}, DST)
        assert st == 200, st

        def signed_manifest(snapshot, after, ndjson):
            m = {
                "snapshot": snapshot,
                "filters": {"after": after, "limit": 1000},
                "count": ndjson.count("\n"),
                "alg": "SHA-256",
                "digest": hashlib.sha256(ndjson.encode()).hexdigest(),
                "signer_did": signer_did,
                "key_version": 1,
            }
            m["signature"] = crypto.sign(
                {k: m[k] for k in ("snapshot", "filters", "count", "alg",
                                   "digest", "signer_did", "key_version")},
                signer_priv)
            return m

        rows = [
            {"cursor": c,
             "consumption_id": f"cons-{i:060d}",
             "issuer_did": "did:web:rcpt-issuer.example",
             "presentation_id": f"vp_{i:03d}",
             "consumed_at": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
            for i, c in enumerate([3, 7, 11], 1)
        ]
        ndjson = "".join(
            json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
            for r in rows
        )
        st, body = post("/v1/trust/presentation-sync",
                        {"manifest": signed_manifest(11, 0, ndjson),
                         "ndjson": ndjson}, DST)
        assert st == 201, (st, body)

        def receipt(qs, headers=DST):
            st, raw = get(f"{RECEIPT}?{qs}", headers=headers)
            return st, json.loads(raw.decode() or "null")

        q = (f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
             f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}&nonce=n1")

        # ---- 400 系列 ----
        st, body = receipt("")
        check("缺参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did=v")
        check("缺 nonce 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(q + "&extra=1")
        check("未知参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(q + "&nonce=n2")
        check("重复参数 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did=&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=n1")
        check("空 signer 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=")
        check("空 nonce 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        long_nonce = "x" * 257
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={signer_did}&verifier_did={verifier_did}"
            f"&nonce={long_nonce}")
        check("nonce 超长 400", st == 400 and body == {"error": "请求非法"})
        n256 = "x" * 256
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}&nonce={n256}")
        check("nonce 256 码点合法", st == 200)
        st, body = get(f"{RECEIPT}?{q}", headers={"X-Tenant-ID": ""})
        check("空租户头 400", st == 400)

        # ---- 404 / 409 ----
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did=did:web:nope&verifier_did={verifier_did}&nonce=n1")
        check("来源不存在 404", st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did=did:web:nope&nonce=n1")
        check("验证者不存在 404",
              st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(q, headers=OTHER)
        check("跨租户 404", st == 404 and body == {"error": "资源不存在"})
        st, body = receipt(
            f"signer_did={urllib.parse.quote(signer_did)}"
            f"&verifier_did={urllib.parse.quote(dead_did)}&nonce=n1")
        check("验证者停用 409",
              st == 409 and body == {"error": "验证者已停用"})

        # ---- 200 ----
        st, body = receipt(q)
        check("200 键序", st == 200 and list(body) == ["receipt", "signature"])
        r = body["receipt"]
        check("receipt 键序", list(r) == [
            "signer_did", "next_after", "digest", "verifier_did",
            "verifier_key_version", "nonce"])
        check("next_after", r["next_after"] == 11)
        check("nonce 回显", r["nonce"] == "n1")
        check("signer/verifier 回显",
              r["signer_did"] == signer_did and
              r["verifier_did"] == verifier_did)
        check("版本正整数", isinstance(r["verifier_key_version"], int)
              and r["verifier_key_version"] >= 1)
        expect_digest = hashlib.sha256(ndjson.encode()).hexdigest()
        check("digest", r["digest"] == expect_digest)

        # 签名可验：取验证者 DID 文档公钥
        st, raw = get(f"/v1/dids/{urllib.parse.quote(verifier_did)}/document",
                      headers=DST)
        doc = json.loads(raw)
        pub_pem = doc["verification_method"][0]["public_key_pem"] \
            if "verification_method" in doc else doc["public_key"]
        try:
            crypto.verify(r, body["signature"], pub_pem)
            check("签名可验", True)
        except Exception as exc:
            print("verify error:", exc)
            check("签名可验", False)

        # 只读：再次请求结果一致（除签名随机性外 receipt 相同）
        st, body2 = receipt(q)
        check("重复请求 receipt 相同", body2["receipt"] == r)

        # ---- 重启后 receipt/digest 相同、签名可验 ----
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()
        proc = start()
        st, body3 = receipt(q)
        check("重启后 receipt 相同", body3["receipt"] == r)
        try:
            crypto.verify(body3["receipt"], body3["signature"], pub_pem)
            check("重启后签名可验", True)
        except Exception:
            check("重启后签名可验", False)
    finally:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait()
        if os.path.exists(store_path):
            os.unlink(store_path)

    if failures:
        print("\n失败:", failures)
        sys.exit(1)
    print("\n全部通过")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
